turns.doctor_question: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hello, Doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. I, um... I hope I'm not taking up too much of your valuable time. 

I came in because... well, I don't know if I'm explaining this right, but I just feel like I cannot settle inside my own skin anymore. It's probably just me being a bit silly, but I always feel like I have to jump up and do the next thing around the house. Even when I'm just completely worn out and I know I should just be sitting still and resting, I just have to get up. 

Does that make sense? I hope I'm answering your question okay.

symptom_reasoning.S012: The patient describes an internal feeling of being unable to settle and a constant urge to jump up and move even when exhausted and needing to sit still, which clearly indicates feeling restless.

turns.doctor_question: When you feel this urge to jump up and do things, do you also find it hard to focus on one task, or do you often start things without finishing them?
turns.patient_response:
Oh, you're... you're very insightful to ask that. I try so hard to be helpful and stay on top of things, I really do, but... well, I suppose I do get a little sidetracked sometimes. I hope that doesn't make me sound terribly lazy or irresponsible. 

Like, for instance, I volunteer with a quilting charity. If the ladies give me three or four things to take care of, I always start the first one right away—because I really want to do a good job for them! But then, I don't know, I just sort of... wander off into another little chore around the house without meaning to. And then I realize later that the last steps of what they actually asked me to do just... never got done. 

I feel so awful when I let them down like that, I promise I don't do it on purpose. Is that the kind of thing you were asking about? I want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.

Well, I... I suppose it's a little bit of both, maybe? I hope I'm not being confusing. I just... I like to keep busy, you know? It's good to be helpful.

I just go from one thing to the next without really taking a breath. 

It's not that I'm terribly anxious, I don't think. I just... it almost feels like if I stop moving, everything will just fall apart. Or maybe it's just that my body won't quite let me sit down and rest, even when I know I probably should at my age. Does that sound like what you were asking? I really want to make sure I'm explaining it the way you need me to.
